description: A small open cardboard box sits on the left side of the table, with a closed laptop in the middle and an open notebook with a pen on the right, plus a few loose items and cloths nearby. The left hand holds the cardboard box steady while the right hand repeatedly reaches rightward to pick up a green cloth, an orange cloth, a black-and-red bottle, a white paper cup, and a small blue packet, then moves back left to drop each item into the box before the left hand slides the filled box toward the left to clear the laptop area.
